entities.title: Describe the workflows as a capability with operations and a use case
entities.summary: The workflows test, gate and deploy every game, but .github/.dev holds only a folder record.
acceptanceCriteria: A component diagram of the workflows and their scripts.
pipeline and delivery records for the repository as a whole, linking each game's own.
A capability, Continuous delivery, with operations for changed-games.sh, last-deployed.sh, migration-gate.sh and the Run workflow dispatch.
A use case, Ship a change to a game, with the owner or a coding agent as actor and GitHub supporting, through ci.yml, migrations.yml and deploy.yml.

origin.description: The owner asked for a plan to refactor retro-games so that it shows everything the cyberspace explorer can show, and approved its Phase 0.

entities.title: A check that the behaviour views link up
entities.summary: Nothing checks that each feature reaches a capability or a use case, or that each operation belongs to a capability.
acceptanceCriteria: A script in .github/scripts/ lists every feature with no capability or use case among its related views, and every operation with no capability.
ci.yml runs it, once the behaviour-chain item in games/ has left it nothing to report.
